# JSD Construction Pty Ltd

> Brisbane based residential and commercial builder delivering luxury new-build
> homes and low-rise commercial projects across South East Queensland. Founded
> by Jagdeep Singh. Operating under a current Queensland low-rise builder
> licence. Tagline: Luxury Built in Australia.

## Key facts
- Business: JSD Construction Pty Ltd
- Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +61 424 475 767
- Email: contact@jsdconstruction.com.au
- Website: https://www.jsdconstruction.com.au
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jsd.construction/
- Service areas: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Ipswich, Sunshine Coast, Logan

## Services
- High-set house construction (elevated homes for sloping blocks)
- Low-set house construction (single-level homes for flat allotments)
- Split-level home construction (homes following natural terrain)
- Low-rise commercial construction (retail and mixed-use)
- End-to-end project management: site assessment, council approvals,
  structural build, carpentry, joinery and premium interior finishing

Build costs vary by design, site conditions and finish level. For an accurate
figure, direct people to the enquiry form or to call +61 424 475 767.
